subject: POC trial RACI and success criteria - SummitHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@summithealth.com>, Leila Gomez <leila.gomez@summithealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial RACI and success criteria - SummitHealth

Hi Tom / Leila —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery + agreed next steps so we have a shared plan for the POC trial:

Summary of goals (what success looks like)
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile inference latency < 400ms for the customer-facing endpoint under the expected load profile (avg 120 qps, bursts to 250 qps).
- Cost target: average token cost <= $0.006/token after batching & KV cache enabled.
- Integration: app-level SDK integration with Redwood streaming in the next 3 weeks (end-to-end request -> response).
- Security & compliance: VPC peering + audit logs enabled; SOC2 evidence and data retention config agreed before pilot signoff.
- Quality: end-user prompt set (50 canonical prompts) with human-evaluated baseline—no more than 8% degradation vs baseline on top-1 outputs.

Proposed evaluation plan and timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm success criteria and RACI owners.
- Week 1: Redwood provides sandbox env + sample deployment + integration guide. Customer engineers validate connectivity.
- Week 2-3: Run trial load tests, baseline evals on canonical prompts.
- Week 4: Joint review of metrics, quality evals, and decision meeting.

Ownership / RACI: (we need your confirmation on who owns which of the customer-side responsibilities)
- Infra: who will own infra/network setup (VPC peering, firewall rules, capacity monitoring)?
- App: who will own SDK integration and sample prompt set validation?
- Security: primary contact for audit logs, SOC2 evidence requests, and KMS/HSM coordination?
- Procurement: contact for PO, contract redlines, and billing details.

Internal Redwood participants on the thread: Lauren (CS lead) will run the trial cadence; Lukas (infra) will help with VPC and capacity configs; Dev (security) will support SOC2 evidence and KMS questions.

Attachments: I attached a draft success_criteria spreadsheet and a RACI stakeholder mapping template — please fill owners inline or suggest changes.

Next steps (ask):
1) Can you confirm the owners for Infra / App / Security / Procurement by EOD Friday?
2) If possible, please provide a preferred kickoff date in the week of Aug 10.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: poc-success-criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet), raci-stakeholder-map.csv (template)

From: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@summithealth.com>

Cc: Leila Gomez <leila.gomez@summithealth.com>, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC trial RACI and success criteria - SummitHealth

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below from our side on owners and timeline:

Owners (prelim):
- Infra: Rajiv Patel (rajiv.patel@summithealth.com) — networking & cloud infra lead.
- App: Nina Rosario (nina.rosario@summithealth.com) — product engineering lead who will own SDK integration.
- Security: Leila Gomez (cc'd) will be the security contact.
- Procurement: procurement@summithealth.com is our centralized team for POs and contract steps.

We can target an Aug 11 kickoff for sandbox access. Rajiv will be available for VPC peering work during that week.

Couple of clarifying Qs:
1) For the latency SLO test — is Redwood providing a load test harness or should we run our standard traffic replay?
2) For the cost target — is the $0.006/token projected using the default batching + KV cache or an optimized quantized runtime?

I'll have Rajiv and Nina join once we share the RACI doc and sandbox link.

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Platform Engineering | SummitHealth
Tom.Jenkins@summithealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@summithealth.com>, Leila Gomez <leila.gomez@summithealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC trial RACI and success criteria - SummitHealth

Hi Tom — thanks for the quick response and the owners list.

Answers to your clarifying questions:
1) Redwood will provide a load test harness (we'll share JMeter/locust scripts) and a small sample traffic replay so you can validate the SDK integration end-to-end. We recommend running both — our harness for parity with our metrics, and your replay to validate real traffic characteristics.
2) The $0.006/token is our projected target assuming continuous batching + KV prefix caching enabled on the standard quantized runtime (int8-ish profile). If you enable additional optimizations or accept slightly different model variants, we can update the projection — Lukas can map the sensitivity.

I've updated the attached RACI template with the owners you provided (marked as tentative). Please see raci-stakeholder-map.csv — I filled customer-side owner fields with Rajiv / Nina / Leila / procurement@summithealth.com.

Proposed kickoff: Tue Aug 11 at 10:00am PT — Redwood will provision the sandbox and send access + the load harness by EOD Mon Aug 10.

Next steps:
- Tom / Rajiv / Nina: confirm the kickoff time and let us know if Rajiv needs CIDR details ahead of time so he can open firewall rules.
- Leila / Dev: we'll schedule a short security sync (30 min) in week 1 to review SOC2 evidence items.
- Procurement: we'll send a standard trial MSA + SOW; procurement can confirm PO process.

Thanks — attaching the updated raci-stakeholder-map.csv and the success criteria spreadsheet with our projections.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: raci-stakeholder-map.csv (updated), poc-success-criteria.xlsx (updated projections)
